title: Seagrove Beach "Wouldn't It Be Nice" 90 Brown Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "Wouldn't It Be Nice" 90 Brown Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Parking lot is available at Eastern Lake Beach Access- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $30 per day**- 2 nearby beach accesses- Ram's Gate and Eastern Lake- Professionally decorated- Stainless steel appliances- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: “Wouldn’t It Be Nice” is a 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 12. Close to 2 beach accesses, this beach cottage has a private pool, balconies, and is professionally decorated in a modern beach style. A delightful, screened porch opens to a living, dining, and kitchen space with views of a large pool and courtyard. Dark wood floors and white, neutral tones create a relaxing space for friends and family to gather in throughout the home. A wonderful chaise sectional sofa and chairs surround a gas fireplace and flat-screen TV. The area is brightened by sunlight spilling through glass doors that open to a generous courtyard and pool. Guests can sleep beneath palm trees or get a few laps in before the day gets busy. A shaded outdoor sitting area is a comfortable spot to eat lunch cooked on the gas grill. Stepping back inside, guests will see a sleek dining table sitting beside a kitchen with premium stainless-steel appliances and a granite-topped island with a gas cooktop and chairs for 4. Interesting cabinet details and shiplap lend a nautical feel to the space. Across from the kitchen is a primary bedroom with a king bed. Sliding glass doors open from the bedroom to the outdoor sitting area and pool. A private bathroom has double sinks, a deep soaking tub, and a separate shower. A roomy desk at the landing on the second floor is an out-of-the-way spot to catch up on work. Guests may select between 3 guest bedrooms and a bunk bedroom. 2 guest bedrooms offer king beds, private bathrooms with showers, and doors that open to a balcony overlooking the pool. The third guest bedroom has a queen bed and shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with the bunk bedroom. 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds are built-in, and each has its own reading light. Explore shopping and dining in Seagrove Beach easily on 5 included adult bikes. Guests are sure to love the deep swimming pool and beautiful interiors. Book “Wouldn’t It Be Nice” before it’s gone because that wouldn’t be nice at all.
